messages:
Kai (Support): Escalating Aperture trial account — SSO completes but embed ingest returns 403 for trial users. Renewal discussion in 5 days, customer called this out as a blocker for their pilot. :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): Acknowledged. Please paste the minimal repro and any error traces. I'll draft a short comms plan and loop in the account owner.
Kai (Support): Repro (seen on prod & staging):
```
GET /auth/okta/callback 302 -> /app/home
POST /embed/ingest 403 {"error":"forbidden", "reason":"mapping-table-mismatch"}
```
Kai (Support): Account meta: aperture-trial, region=us-west-2, SSO=Okta. Tried rotating keys and flushing proxy cache, no change. Owner: @lucy.aperture, PST.
Rohit (Eng): Looking into routing logs. I see a recent config push to routing-policies that removed the legacy "trial-*" mapping entries during a cleanup. That explains mapping-table-mismatch. Rebuilding mapping and reloading now.
Ava (Solutions): Draft comms recommendation: (1) immediate acknowledgement + 30m ETA; (2) provide manual workaround (console mapping + temporary API call) so they can continue their demo; (3) schedule a 30-min enablement session and record it for their team; (4) offer a one-time service credit for the disruption and capture feedback via a short 4-question survey. I'll draft copy and KB link.
Maya (CS): Good plan. Kai — did the customer ask for phone or email? I'll make the outreach and set the expectation.
Kai (Support): Lucy prefers email. I sent an update and linked the placeholder sync at 14:30 PST. Customer replied: "Thanks. We need this resolved before our internal demo tomorrow"
deploy-bot: config-reload-start routing-policies-patch-178555 1785554400
Rohit (Eng): Patch applied and mapping table restored. Reload succeeded. Running smoke tests now.
deploy-bot: config-reload-succeeded routing-policies-patch-178555 1785554478
Rohit (Eng): Smoke tests show auth -> embed flow working for aperture-trial. Repro no longer returns 403.
Maya (CS): I'll confirm with @lucy.aperture and propose the recorded enablement session to walk through their flow and capture any friction points. I'll also note the one-time credit offer and attach the feedback survey link.
Kai (Support): Closing the support ticket and flagging this thread as escalated->CS for follow-ups: enablement invite, customer-facing summary, survey capture, and renewal touchpoint.
Ava (Solutions): I'll send the invite with the manual mapping steps and a short timeline of events (what happened, what we changed, and how to avoid in future). KB ref: https://redwood.internal/kb/routing-policies#trial-mapping. Also adding the 4-question survey link in the email.
Maya (CS): Assigning follow-ups: 1) Enablement session owner: Ava; 2) Customer-facing postmortem + technical note: Rohit + Kai; 3) Renewal readiness check in 3 days: Maya — I'll update CRM and include the recorded session and survey results. :white_check_mark:
Rohit (Eng): Adding a short regression test for trial mappings to our CI to prevent this in future.
Kai (Support): Thanks team  quick and smooth.
Maya (CS): Closing this Slack thread for support; CS will own the enablement and feedback capture ahead of renewal.
